error[ZC-E0106]: the server's configuration can't be used
  cause  the store is nosql:x; it must be memory, sqlite:<path> or
         postgres:<settings>
  fix    name a store zcube-server supports
  more   zcube explain E0106 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0106.html
